title: Italian Wrap
description: A quick and easy Italian-inspired wrap filled with ham, mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil. Perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: Wrap the tortilla in a damp paper towel and microwave for 20-30 seconds to make it pliable.
Lay the wrap flat and arrange 2 slices of ham in the center of the wrap.
Top the ham with 2 slices of mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Add chopped fresh basil leaves on top of the cheese.
Roll the wrap tightly to form a compact roll.
Place the roll seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
